groups.label: 🚨 Blockers — install before any pillar pages go live
groups.description: These 4 items must be done Day 1 morning. Without them, the 6 pillar + 3 blog drafts will not rank and you may break existing content.

items.why: CRITICAL — no SEO plugin currently. The 6 pillar + 3 blog drafts all assume Rank Math for meta + schema + sitemap.
items.how: Plugins > Add New > search 'Rank Math SEO' > Install > Activate. Run setup wizard.

items.task: Change site title from PixelPierNYC to Prime Bridge Media
items.why: Brand confusion in Google + browser tab. Also update tagline.
items.how: Settings > General > Site Title: Prime Bridge Media > Tagline: Digital Marketing Agency in Chandigarh-Tricity

groups.label: 🟠 Critical — do these on Day 1
groups.description: Cleanup + security patches. Do all of these before publishing pillars/blogs.

items.why: Conflicts with Object Cache Pro (only one can win)
Comment spam arrives within days of blog posts going live
items.how: Plugins > Installed > Akismet > Activate > Get free API key from akismet.com

items.why: PixelPierNYC demo content (artists, job posts) competes with PBM content in Google
items.how: Use Bulk Edit to change status to Draft for all PixelPierNYC items. OR install Post Status Notifier plugin.
Dashboard > Updates > Update Elementor Pro. Verify layouts intact after.

groups.label: 🟡 Should-do — finish in Week 1
groups.description: Polish + housekeeping. Skip nothing critical if time-pressed.

items.task: Delete VamTam Importers + Hello Dolly plugins
items.why: VamTam Importers = demo content importer (no longer needed). Hello Dolly = useless.

items.how: Dashboard > Updates > Update. May require VamTam license for auto-update; manual upload otherwise.

items.why: Site Health flagged: inactive themes = security risk
Site Health flagged. PHP 8.3 is faster + WordPress 7.0 recommends it.
items.how: SSH: sudo apt install php8.3 php8.3-fpm php8.3-mysql php8.3-xml php8.3-curl php8.3-mbstring, then switch FPM pool

groups.label: 🔵 Verification — external services
groups.description: Get your site verified by Google + Bing + set up booking. Required for tracking + listings.

items.why: Track impressions / clicks / rankings for the 6 pillars + 3 blogs
items.how: Add DNS TXT record at domain registrar OR upload HTML file. Free, ~10 min.

items.why: Bing search visibility (5% of search market in India)
items.how: bing.com/webmasters > Add site > verify via DNS CNAME

items.task: Set up Cal.com (or alternative) booking link
items.why: All pillar pages + blogs link to this for CTA
items.how: cal.com > Sign up > Connect calendar > Get booking URL
